title: Completion Rule
description: Defines what happens when sub-order(s) of an order reach a given status. A sub-order reaching its own target does NOT automatically complete its parent - e.g. an AutoStore sub-order may only be able to reach its cell's own EXIT point, never the parent order's actual outbound door, so reaching the parent's target requires a further step. This rule expresses that step: either the parent's own status changes, or a new order is spawned (typically a consolidation order whose positions are suborder_output_request entries referencing the completed sub-orders, targeting the original parent's target).

status.description: References a statuses[].id (typically terminal) that sub-orders are watched for.

new_status.description: Required when type is 'update_parent_status' - references a statuses[].id.

spawn_order_type.description: Required when type is 'spawn_order' - which order_type to instantiate (usually the same one the parent belongs to).

spawn_target.description: Required when type is 'spawn_order' - typically the original parent's own target.
